verdict.justification: The project involves designing and implementing a movie recommendation system based on user personality extracted from social networks, using data processing techniques and artificial intelligence algorithms. The system uses the SVD algorithm to predict user ratings for each title and reorders them based on user preferences. User preferences are defined as the affinity between the user's personality and different genres available. This personality can be calculated automatically when a user registers through Twitter or the user has the option to take a personality test. With data preprocessing, the necessary computational models for generating recommendations and predicting user personalities are generated. The development of the application aims to improve the performance of classic recommendation algorithms by including aspects of user personality.
